items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Say, what was your grandfather's name? Bob Welch. Bob Welch. Yes, sir. Same as yours, just about. ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, sir. He was a preacher. He died a preacher.

ctx.x: Let me know when you want to talk. I mean, when you're ready to cut it. I can ask you. Say, what was your grandfather's name? Bob Welch. Bob Welch. Yes, sir. Same as yours, just about. Yes, sir. Oh, I see. And, uh, did he play with bands?
No, sir. He was a preacher. He died a preacher.
